newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank of Israel governor sees good in Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Israel governor sees good in Hebron deal.

text.p: Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel said on Wednesday that the Hebron deal with the PLO had removed uncertainty in Israel's economy and could clear the way for more foreign investment.

"An economy doesn't like uncertainty and it doesn't like a long waiting period. Insofar as the Hebron deal removes the uncertainty, obviously there is a potentially positive effect," Frenkel said on Israel's Channel One Television.

"Foreign investors who want to know which way things are going, the tourists who don't like to go somewhere which has uncertainty -- all of these can see in this agreement something positive," he said.
"And it's very important that the economic policy will now be carried out so that all the potential will be extracted," Frenkel told the television.
Under the deal which Israel initialled with the Palestinians early on Wednesday, 80 percent of the West Bank town of Hebron will be handed over to Palestinian self-rule.
